summary: Frontend-only regression for Browse Providers reachability from all 4 client-type dashboards. All 9 review scenarios PASS: customer /client-home tab switcher (describe default, browse embeds FindProviders with 9 cards + filters working — rate-low filter narrowed cards from 9→2 and toggled back cleanly), landlord/facilities/property dashboards all expose data-testid='dashboard-find-providers' quick-action linking to /find-providers page. Mobile viewport (390x844) also renders tabs and embedded catalog correctly with all 9 cards.
critical_code_review_comments: ClientHome.jsx JSX indentation for the describe branch is inconsistent (starts at column 4 inside a col-6 wrapper) — cosmetic only, not a bug.
Tab state 'tab' is not persisted in URL/query — deep-linking to /client-home?tab=browse not supported. Consider syncing to searchParams for shareable links.
test_credentials: Registered ephemeral users qa-{role}-{ts}@dispatchr.demo / testpass123 for customer, landlord, facilities, property.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 client-type roles can reach provider catalog in one click: customer via inline tab on /client-home (home-tab-browse), landlord/facilities/property via dashboard-find-providers card → /find-providers. Regression clean. Provider cards testid 'provider-card-*', filter testids 'filter-rate-*', 'filter-min_rating-*' all present in embedded context.
